name: T-Mobile Essentials Saver 2.0

eligibilityCriteria: Available to both new and existing T-Mobile single or dual-line customers

name: T-Mobile Go5G
autoPayAssumptions: Pricing reflects a $5/line monthly discount with eligible AutoPay using a linked checking account (ACH) or debit card ($10 discount for 2 lines, $15 discount for 3 lines). Without AutoPay, cost is $80 for 1 line, $140 for 2 lines, and $170 for 3 lines. Note on advertised rates: T-Mobile promotional marketing frequently advertises 3 lines for $130 by applying a conditional '3rd Line on Us' monthly bill credit for qualifying new account activations, but the standard non-promotional recurring rate per Broadband Facts is $155 with AutoPay ($170 undiscounted).
taxAndFeeAssumptions: Monthly recurring service plan pricing INCLUDES standard regulatory fees and monthly sales taxes for qualifying consumer accounts.
dataAndHotspotFeatures: 100 GB premium high-speed mobile data per month before potential deprioritization
15 GB high-speed mobile hotspot data included, then unlimited at 3G speeds
Monthly taxes and regulatory fees included in base service price
Standard non-promotional 3-line pricing is $155 with AutoPay ($170 without AutoPay)
eligibilityCriteria: Available to both new and existing T-Mobile accounts
Supports accounts with 1 to 5+ voice lines
